data.one_liner: Feature‑rich audio player for Flutter supporting gapless playlists and multiple sources
data.what_it_does: just_audio provides a Flutter plugin that can play audio from assets, files, URLs or streams. It supports gapless playlists, looping, shuffling, headers, caching and background audio.
use_when: Playing audio in a Flutter app
Creating gapless playlists or multi‑track sequences
avoid_when: Replacing native audio frameworks for low‑level audio processing
Using it in non‑Flutter native projects
strengths: Wide platform support (Android, iOS, macOS, web, Linux, Windows)
Rich API for playlists, looping, shuffling and headers
Gapless playback and precise position control
weaknesses: Requires native configuration for HTTP headers (proxy or native APIs)
Some features need platform‑specific setup (e.g., Android AGP, iOS audio session)
data.setup_notes: Add just_audio to pubspec, run flutter pub get. For HTTP headers enable non‑HTTPS proxy support on Android/iOS/macOS or set useProxyForRequestHeaders:false. Update Android build files for AGP 9 if using older projects.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler API, fewer native dependencies, good for basic playback

alternatives.name: media_kit
alternatives.why_pick_it: More advanced media handling, supports video and advanced features
